jobs.state_note: Root cause confirmed via stderr.797043: solver segfaulted ~2.8s after launch (never reached cycle 1 -- converge.log stayed at 396 lines the entire 2hr allocation because it crashed during pipeline setup, before any time-stepping). 12 of 13 Catalyst scripts (all except XTPlot_Pressure.py) had a hardcoded Windows-only absolute path baked in by CONVERGE Studio's trace-export (e.g. CONVERGECFDReader(FileName='C:\\Users\\nsmichno\\Documents\\triangleRDE_weakIgnite\\outputs_original/output/post000001_+0.00000e+00.h5')) -- that path doesn't exist on the Linux cluster, HDF5 failed to open it, and the unhandled failure segfaulted converge itself on multiple ranks. The job then sat dead until SLURM's epilogue ran mark_job_complete at the wall-limit boundary, which is why it looked like a live hang from file state alone. FIXED 2026-09-11: all 12 affected scripts in this directory now use the same relative-path pattern already proven working in XTPlot_Pressure.py ('outputs_original/output/post000001_+0.00000e+00.h5'). Not yet re-tested -- awaiting resubmission.

jobs.summary: Job 797043 did not hang -- it segfaulted ~2.8s after launch, before ever reaching cycle 1, because 12 of its 13 Catalyst scripts had a hardcoded Windows-only path (a CONVERGE Studio trace-export artifact) that doesn't resolve on the Linux cluster. HDF5's failed open segfaulted the solver outright; the job then sat as a zombie until SLURM enforced the 2hr wall limit and ran its completion epilogue. All 12 affected scripts have now been fixed to use the same relative path already working in XTPlot_Pressure.py. The fix has not yet been tested with a resubmission.

notes.txt: Root cause confirmed: hardcoded Windows path in 12/13 Catalyst scripts caused an immediate segfault, not a hang. Job never reached cycle 1.

Fixed 2026-09-11: all 12 scripts (EquivMetricSurf + 3 XY stations, PressureSurf x3 + PressureWallSurf, TemperatureSurf x3 + TemperatureWallSurf) now use the relative post-file path pattern from XTPlot_Pressure.py.
Fix is unverified -- needs a resubmission to confirm it actually gets past mesh setup and into time-stepping.

jobs.summary: Job 269785 ended via TERM_RUNLIMIT at the 2-hour short-queue wall limit (exit 140, not a crash) -- cycle 188, t=10.54us of the 4000us target, zero FATAL_ERROR for the entire run. Primary goal achieved: ParaView Catalyst is confirmed working under CONVERGE 5.0.2 for the first time ever on this project -- 9 of 10 registered scripts produced 22 real PNG frames apiece. XTPlot_Pressure remains the one holdout: it received the same 22 triggers as every other script (well past the ~20-call threshold that should have forced its first periodic save) but produced zero output and zero errors. This rules out 'just needs more sim time' -- the likely cause is a silent early-return in _extract_ring_arrays (empty resample data -> function returns before ever incrementing the save counter, no exception raised).

notes.txt: Ended via TERM_RUNLIMIT (2hr wall limit), not a crash -- exit code 140, zero FATAL_ERROR for the full run.
Catalyst confirmed working under CONVERGE 5.0.2: 9/10 scripts produced 22 frames each, resolving the long-standing 4.1.2 library-load failure.

XTPlot_Pressure produced zero output despite 22 triggers (past its own periodic-save threshold) and zero errors in the logs -- points to a silent early-return in _extract_ring_arrays, not a timing/pacing issue as earlier assumed. Needs direct debugging of the resample/ring-extraction code.
